notes.title: Yoram Feature improvement & bug fixes
notes.content:
Feature Improvements
Added highlight functionality for some selectable options.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the notebook and settings screens overlapped.

Fixed an issue where unintended scripts were displayed in the log screen.

Fixed an issue where the cancel button and the game menu button overlapped in the log screen.

Fixed an issue where the UI would unexpectedly disappear in certain situations.

Fixed an issue where unintended UI elements would appear in certain situations.

Fixed an issue where the question prompt did not appear during arguments after saving and loading the game.

Fixed an issue where text was not displayed correctly after changing the resolution.

Team Yoram will continue to do our best. Thank you.

notes.title: Yoram Bug Fixes and Feature Improvements
notes.content:
Feature Improvements
Progress guidance is now displayed during situations that require specific actions.

Added key binding to allow advancing tutorial and TIP messages with the Enter key.

Pressing ESC in the log now only closes the log instead of opening the settings menu.

You can now scroll through text using the Z key and mouse wheel.

Shortcut key info (F) is now displayed on the diary (notebook) ribbon bookmark.


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where pressing ESC during an argument would close the notebook.

Fixed an issue where some event popups appeared behind characters.

Fixed an issue where some UI elements were broken in the settings menu.

Fixed an issue where font size changes in the settings were not applied.

Fixed an issue where game setting values were not properly saved.


Localization Fixes
(Korean) Fixed punctuation marks such as , . ! ? breaking in some sections.

(English, Japanese) Fixed an issue where some affinity increase messages were shown in Korean.

(English, Japanese) Fixed an issue where the “cannot move” message was displayed in Korean.

(Japanese) Fixed additional broken UI elements in the settings menu.


Known but Unresolved Issue
When the diary is opened during a debate, clicking on another bookmark triggers unintended behavior.



We will continue to bring you ongoing feature improvements and bug fixes!

notes.title: Yoram Demo Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Game Settings
Fixed an issue where the game’s text setting values were not being saved.

Fixed an issue where the skip mode reset did not function properly.

Fixed an issue where category text would not update when the language or font size was changed.

Fixed an issue where font size changes in the settings were not applied in real time.

Added the UISetting Preview Printer feature, allowing users to preview changes in advance.

※ Saving sound settings will be supported starting from the next patch.
[hr][/hr]UI/UX
Fixed an issue where mouse hover did not work in the Free Movement window.

Fixed an issue where text was cut off or languages were hidden in some UI elements during conversations.

Fixed an issue where some of Dorothy’s lines were incorrectly shown as spoken by Irene.

Fixed an issue (Japanese only) where Side Toast text appeared broken during Dorothy’s assist in the first argument with Amelia.
[hr][/hr]Quest & Translation
Fixed an issue where quest messages were not translated when saved in a different language.

Fixed a mistake in the diary where Ernest was incorrectly labeled as “Amelia’s son.”

Fixed an issue (Japanese only) where Higgins’ name extended beyond the UI bounds.

Fixed an issue (Japanese only) where text appeared broken in Dorothy’s assist section.

Fixed an issue where the diary could not be opened during the transcription segment.

notes.title: Yoram Demo bug fixe
notes.content: Fixed a bug that made it impossible to proceed normally during the first debate with Amelia.
